name: app-view
title: App view
description: A full-window product view with no site header or footer, built on the AppView frame from @atom63/ui-react/layout: a top bar across the window, a side panel and the main region below it, and an optional bar docked at the bottom, such as a media player or a status bar. chrome="flush" runs the columns to the window edges, split by borders, instead of rounded cards. layout="phone" makes it a phone app screen: edge to edge, the top bar optional, safe-area aware, phone-sized type and controls (body 17px, 44px controls), and the tab-bar block docked at the bottom. overlay floats content over the main region, such as a scroll-to-bottom button. For a dense product view (a table, an inbox, an issue tracker, an admin dashboard, a file list), wrap it in <UIProvider density="compact">. Import AppView; copy only the sample pages to adapt them.
